_comment: Team DEF/ST ranking, best first. Sleeper's /players/nfl dump gives team defenses no search_rank, so Sleepy ranks them from this list instead (rank 1 = first entry). Copy this file to ~/sleepy/def_ranks.json and reorder it to taste before draft day — that copy wins when present. Teams missing from the list sort last, alphabetically. The default order below is a generic preseason consensus placeholder, not a projection — edit it.
